summary: Mississippi Forestry Commission's 100 ft Aermotor LS-40 tower in Yazoo County, registered 2023; the register says the site is still maintained; no build date found.

facts.design: 100 ft Aermotor LS-40 tower; site also has the original work shed and a small office/residence

events.note: Register lists a site visit on 7/2/23; its description says the site is still maintained by the MFC

evidence.supports: administered by the Mississippi Forestry Commission

evidence.quote: The tower is a 100ft Aermotor LS-40.

evidence.quote: This site is still being maintained by the MFC.

evidence.supports: original work shed and small office/residence on site
evidence.quote: The site also contains the original work shed and a small office/residence.

notes_for_editor: Thin sources: the NHLR register page and an OSM node. No build year, designer, staffing, or fire history was found. OSM's lattice tag supports the tower type but gives no date. The record's material is null and is left unchanged. The register names a nominator; that name is omitted here. Record elevation 117.7 m matches 386 ft (118 m). The register does not say whether the public may visit, so access is left out of facts.
